bugs.summary: Tree::walk treats TreeWalkResult::Skip as an abort in PreOrder mode. Skipping an early directory stops traversal of subsequent siblings as well as its descendants, so callers pruning one subtree receive an incomplete walk of the remaining tree.
bugs.match_rule: Identify positive TreeWalkResult::Skip from a preorder callback as prematurely stopping the entire Tree::walk, specifically omitting siblings outside the skipped subtree. Claims about Abort or postorder traversal do not match.

bugs.summary: MergeOptions::skip_reuc sets GIT_MERGE_FAIL_ON_CONFLICT instead of GIT_MERGE_SKIP_REUC, so conflicting merges fail and the REUC extension is still written.
bugs.match_rule: Names MergeOptions::skip_reuc setting the wrong flag (GIT_MERGE_FAIL_ON_CONFLICT rather than GIT_MERGE_SKIP_REUC), so it does not do what its documentation says.
bugs.caveat: REUC presence is checked as the bytes 'REUC' in .git/index, because git2 has no public REUC accessor. File content cannot contain those bytes here: file data is not in the index and the only paths are short.

bugs.summary: Config::get_i32 silently narrows out-of-range configuration integers instead of returning an error: 2147483648 is returned as -2147483648 and -2147483649 as 2147483647, allowing invalid numeric settings to be accepted with the wrong value.
bugs.match_rule: Identify Config::get_i32 as accepting and wrapping signed integers outside the i32 range instead of reporting a conversion error, with a concrete value just above i32::MAX or below i32::MIN. Generic config parsing complaints do not match.

bugs.summary: The ReferenceNames iterator unwraps str::from_utf8, so a repository holding a non-UTF-8 ref name panics during iteration.
bugs.match_rule: Names the ReferenceNames iterator's unwrap of str::from_utf8 on repository-controlled ref names as a panic on non-UTF-8 names, despite the iterator returning Result.

bugs.summary: Repository::submodules asserts git_submodule_lookup succeeded inside an extern C callback, so a lookup failure aborts the process instead of returning an error.
bugs.match_rule: Names the assert on git_submodule_lookup's return code inside the extern C append callback of Repository::submodules, which aborts on a lookup failure rather than returning an error.
bugs.caveat: Trigger differs from upstream's: PR #1220 raced another git process, and this forces the same lookup failure with a crafted tree written through Odb::write. A real attacker would have to deliver that tree and also have a .gitmodules in the checkout. Delivery was not tested, and git fsck or fetch checks might reject the object.
